title: Hareraiser (The Worst Game Ever) - Stuart Ashen - Norwich Gaming Festival 2017
summary: Stuart Ashen presents a talk at the 2017 Norwich Gaming Festival on Hareraiser, a notoriously bad video game tied to the Masquerade treasure hunt. He explores why it may be the worst game ever made.
why: Recommended as the best video account of the Hareraiser affair when treasure-hunt and puzzle stories come up.
